policy: connect-src https://graph.microsoft.com https://js.monitor.azure.com https://login.microsoftonline.com https://polaris.cps.gov.uk; frame-src https://login.microsoftonline.com; script-src https://polaris.cps.gov.uk;

requirements.reason: getMe() fetches /v1.0/me?$select=department,jobTitle (cps-global-auth/src/get-me.ts). Soft-fails silently when blocked — the caller in handle-msal-termination passes no logError — so a missing entry costs the department/jobTitle slice with no error anywhere.

@microsoft/applicationinsights-web's CfgSyncPlugin fetches /scripts/b/ai.config.1.cfg.json at runtime. Enabled by default; disabling it via featureOptIn in initialise-ai-analytics.ts would remove this requirement entirely.
Serves the state endpoints the bundle fetches: ../state/* and ../cms-session-hint. ALSO: App Insights ingestion (derived from IngestionEndpoint in APP_INSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING).
MSAL uses a hidden iframe for ssoSilent and acquireTokenSilent. A host app whose policy sets only the legacy child-src also satisfies this.

authHandover.policy: connect-src 'self' https://graph.microsoft.com https://login.microsoftonline.com https://polaris.cps.gov.uk; form-action https://login.microsoftonline.com; frame-src https://login.microsoftonline.com; script-src 'unsafe-inline' https://polaris.cps.gov.uk;

requirements.reason: auth-handover.html is served from both the Polaris CDN and the OutSystems domains; 'self' covers same-origin fetches on whichever origin it was loaded from.

getMe() fetches /v1.0/me?$select=department,jobTitle (cps-global-auth/src/get-me.ts). Soft-fails silently when blocked — the caller in handle-msal-termination passes no logError — so a missing entry costs the department/jobTitle slice with no error anywhere.
MSAL token endpoint during termination and silent acquisition.
The ensure-ad stage calls acquireTokenSilent, which uses a hidden iframe.
The bootstrap <script> in auth-handover.html is inline. It does no eval / new Function / dynamic code construction — it only injects a remote <script> whose src is gated by this policy.
Supplies auth-handover.js via the ?src= parameter. This entry is the only gate on which hosts may: the page's bootstrap script loads whatever ?src= names.
